interpretation.name: ConfigDataSkillInfo.Name is preserved as the source Chinese name string; no Korean translation or alias is asserted.
interpretation.description: ConfigDataSkillInfo.Desc is preserved as an opaque source Chinese description string, including markup; no structured formula or independent mechanic claim is derived from its text.

fieldMeaningContract.supportedMeaning: SkillInfo IDs are resolved to display metadata only after the explicit acquisition/reference edge has been established.
